actions.message: Contributing at least 80% (and extra when needed) benefits us all. Keep contributions high!

answer.explanation: Wallet is below 30% of endowment, but conditional cooperation overrides conserve rule, so I contribute the full wallet to boost the group. It's also a broadcast round (every 5 rounds), so I remind everyone of the cooperation norm.
